title: The Episode About the Slaughter of Wazir Khan

blocks.text: The page closes the Banur and Sadhaura thread by showing Hindus protected, Muslims struck, and Majha Singhs summoned by the hill route as the campaign hardens toward Sirhind.
It then opens Episode 38, where the Malerkotla Pathans under Khawaja Khijar and Sher Muhammad move to check the Khalsa advance as Wazir Khan prepares for a more serious contest.
This transition frames the next conflict not as an isolated skirmish but as a widening military theater centered on Khawaja Khijar and the Sirhind response.
